title: AMDY Omarchy 4 Quattro & Quickshell KAD Cyberdeck Theme Implementation
non_scope: granting desktop UI widgets authority to execute mutating shell commands or alter routing
coupling desktop shell lifecycle to remote compute nodes or requiring live SSE daemons for basic theming
acceptance_criteria: Quickshell / QML / LayerShell theme widgets implement Tier A diegetic cyberdeck aesthetic (surface.amdy.quickshell) based on ISA-KAD-AESTHETIC-001 tokens
Hyprland window decoration, border styling, and 45-degree polygon chamfer geometry configured for AMDY workstation (surface.amdy.hyprland)
Terminal 24-bit TrueColor profile and color scheme configured (surface.terminal.omarchy)
Event-driven 200Hz state transitions implemented with 150ms-200ms duration and zero infinite ambient looping animations
WCAG AAA contrast (>14:1) verified for cyan/bone on dark ink/oxblood backgrounds
Strict NO_AUDIO_UI enforcement verified across all desktop widgets
Zero shell mutation authority invariant verified (desktop UI cannot directly execute mutating commands)
Graceful degradation verified: compositor or GPU failure drops cleanly to 0ms monospace / static rendering
Full test suite, ISA checks, and doctors remain GREEN
description: Implement the canonical Tier A diegetic cyberdeck presentation layer on developer workstation amdy across Omarchy 4 Quattro (Hyprland, Quickshell, Waybar, Terminal) enforcing ISA-KAD-AESTHETIC-001 without turning desktop components into compute fabric dependencies or granting UI widgets mutation authority.
